questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Chiavenna was a place that I had no visited before, and I therefore saw it as a unique opportunity to explore something new. The city itself was not very big, and therefore gave the opportunity to explore most of the city. With mountain views and a beautiful nature it gave a new working environment that did not disappoint.

questions.answer: Fairly easy. I had issues accessing the Ariel page, but once it succeeded it was pretty easy.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I, and many others, thought that the teachers would be there when we arrived. This could have been made more clear. But the lady at the hostel provided the necessary information.

How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Overall I thought it was good. Instead of having a new subject for two days, I would do one in order to go in depth, as it got very superficial. I thought it was a bit sad that some got to go on a tour on the last day, where others had to stay home, as I think most would have like to go on a tour instead of doing presentations again. Lastly it would have been nice to know your subject beforehand, so you could read your texts more in depth and thereby being more prepared.
